Revert-verify mutants for the CALLER half of issue #4469 / req 2d072437-c19d-49a4-ae89-f20b6185571f. `set-body` hand-rebuilt the frontmatter block as `---
<body>
---` and glued the body on with a bare `
`; that was dead-but-harmless while `FrontmatterService.parse()` refused every non-LF shape, and this work item's own widening made it HOT. MB1 restores the whole hand-reconstruction (block AND separator); MB2 restores only the separator, which is what separates 'the block's bytes are preserved' from 'the seam after it is the file's own' — two guarantees, two axes. Expectations written BEFORE the run.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/set-body.ts

MB1_hand_rebuilt_block_restored._note: Exactly the pre-#4469 line, including its hardcoded LF fences and the dropped BOM. CH43 (pure LF) stays green — on an LF file the reconstruction happens to be byte-identical, which is precisely why the bug survived until the predicate was widened.

MB2_separator_back_to_a_bare_lf._note: The block itself is preserved, only the seam after the closing fence reverts to a bare LF. CH40 measures the block ALONE (up to the closing fence) so it stays green; CH42 asserts the seam. That the two split cleanly is what shows they are separate guarantees rather than one.
